headline: Palantir Shares Fall as US Commercial Growth Decelerates
summary: Palantir Technologies reported an earnings beat, but its stock dropped as U.S. commercial contract growth decelerated.
why: Palantir Technologies is a public software company specializing in big data analytics for government and enterprise customers.

impacts.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
impacts.why: Palantir stock fell after market participants focused on decelerating growth in U.S. commercial contracts despite an earnings beat.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Palantir stock declined after Wall Street analysts expressed concern over slowing growth in U.S. commercial contracts despite quarterly earnings exceeding expectations.
